messages.author: ee65f9feb643484e
messages.subject: RMSEA calculation
parts:
Dear lavaan group,

As far as I'm aware, RMSEA is usually defined as the square root of max(chisq - df, 0)/(df*(n - 1)).

But as far as I can tell, lavaan uses division by n instead of by (n - 1). I understand that the default behaviour of lavaan is to divide things by n instead of n-1, but even if likelihood="wishart" is used when fitting the model, division by n is still used when calculating RMSEA. What is the reason for this?

Thanks,
Mark
